units.source_text: 藤壶皇后看见源氏公子才艺超群，心中想道：“

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo saw how remarkably gifted Prince Genji was, she thought to herself, "

units.source_text: 太子的母亲弘徽殿女御如此憎恨源氏公子，真不可解。

en.t: It is truly hard to understand why Kokiden, the crown prince's mother, hates Prince Genji so much.

units.source_text: 但我自己如此爱怜他，亦不免疚心。”

en.t: But since I myself care for him so tenderly, I cannot help feeling guilty as well."
She reflected deeply on her own feelings.
